name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: Also known as the Swiss Cheese Plant, this stunning tropical plant features large, glossy leaves with distinctive splits and holes. It's a popular choice for adding a bold, jungle-like aesthetic to any indoor space.

careInstructions.light: Bright indirect sunlight; can tolerate some shade
careInstructions.water: Water when top 2 inches of soil are dry; typically once a week
careInstructions.humidity: Moderate to high; mist regularly for best results

name: Snake Plant
description: One of the most resilient houseplants, the Snake Plant features upright, sword-shaped leaves with striking variegation. Perfect for beginners, it thrives on neglect and purifies indoor air effectively.

careInstructions.light: Low to bright indirect light; very adaptable
careInstructions.water: Allow soil to dry completely between waterings; every 2-3 weeks
careInstructions.humidity: Low to moderate; very drought tolerant

name: Peace Lily
description: Elegant and graceful, the Peace Lily produces beautiful white blooms that rise above lush, dark green foliage. It's an excellent air purifier and signals when it needs water by drooping slightly.

careInstructions.light: Low to medium indirect light; avoid direct sun
careInstructions.water: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged; water weekly
careInstructions.humidity: High; mist regularly or use humidity tray

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: A statement plant with large, violin-shaped leaves that create a dramatic focal point. This trendy houseplant adds sculptural beauty and can grow into an impressive indoor tree with proper care.

careInstructions.light: Bright indirect light; rotate regularly for even growth
careInstructions.water: Water when top inch of soil is dry; typically once a week
careInstructions.humidity: Moderate to high; wipe leaves to remove dust

name: Golden Pothos
description: A versatile trailing vine with heart-shaped leaves splashed with golden yellow. Extremely easy to care for and propagate, it looks beautiful in hanging baskets or cascading from shelves.

careInstructions.light: Low to bright indirect light; very adaptable
careInstructions.water: Water when soil feels dry; every 7-10 days
careInstructions.humidity: Average household humidity is fine

name: ZZ Plant
description: With glossy, oval-shaped leaves on elegant upright stems, the ZZ Plant is virtually indestructible. It tolerates low light and irregular watering, making it perfect for offices or low-maintenance spaces.

careInstructions.light: Low to bright indirect light; very tolerant
careInstructions.water: Allow soil to dry completely; water every 2-3 weeks
careInstructions.humidity: Low; very drought tolerant

name: Rubber Plant
description: Features large, thick, glossy leaves in deep green or burgundy shades. This robust plant makes a bold architectural statement and can grow quite tall indoors with the right conditions.

careInstructions.light: Bright indirect light; can tolerate some direct morning sun
careInstructions.water: Water when top 2 inches of soil are dry; weekly in summer
careInstructions.humidity: Moderate; wipe leaves occasionally

name: Spider Plant
description: Characterized by arching leaves with green and white stripes, this plant produces baby plantlets on long stems. One of the easiest plants to grow and propagate, perfect for hanging displays.

careInstructions.light: Bright indirect light; tolerates some shade
careInstructions.water: Keep soil lightly moist; water when top inch is dry
careInstructions.humidity: Average; tolerant of various conditions

name: Aloe Vera
description: A succulent with thick, fleshy leaves containing healing gel. Besides being decorative, Aloe Vera has medicinal properties and is incredibly low-maintenance, perfect for sunny windowsills.

careInstructions.light: Bright direct or indirect light; needs at least 6 hours daily
careInstructions.water: Water deeply but infrequently; every 2-3 weeks
careInstructions.humidity: Low; very drought tolerant

name: Jade Plant
description: A succulent with thick, woody stems and plump, oval leaves. Often called the money tree, this long-lived plant can grow into a miniature tree shape and symbolizes good fortune and prosperity.

careInstructions.light: Bright light with some direct sun; south-facing window ideal
careInstructions.water: Water when soil is completely dry; every 2-3 weeks
careInstructions.humidity: Low; prefers dry conditions

name: Heartleaf Philodendron
description: Fast-growing vine with glossy, heart-shaped leaves. This classic houseplant is forgiving and versatile, thriving in various conditions and looking beautiful trailing from shelves or climbing a moss pole.

careInstructions.light: Low to bright indirect light; very adaptable
careInstructions.water: Water when top inch of soil is dry; weekly
careInstructions.humidity: Average to high; mist occasionally

name: Hibiscus
description: Tropical flowering plant producing large, showy blooms in vibrant colors. These spectacular flowers add a pop of color to gardens and patios, blooming prolifically throughout warm months.

careInstructions.light: Full sun; at least 6 hours of direct sunlight daily
careInstructions.water: Keep soil consistently moist; water daily in hot weather
careInstructions.humidity: Moderate to high; tolerates outdoor humidity

name: Jasmine
description: Climbing vine or shrub famous for intensely fragrant, delicate white or yellow flowers. The intoxicating scent fills gardens in evening hours, making it a favorite for outdoor spaces and entryways.

careInstructions.light: Full sun to partial shade; at least 4-6 hours of sun
careInstructions.water: Keep soil moist but not waterlogged; water regularly
careInstructions.humidity: Moderate to high; benefits from morning dew

name: Rose
description: Classic flowering shrub available in countless varieties and colors. Roses are the ultimate garden flower, offering beauty, fragrance, and elegance. Perfect for borders, hedges, or as standalone features.

careInstructions.light: Full sun; minimum 6 hours of direct sunlight
careInstructions.water: Water deeply 2-3 times per week; more in hot weather
careInstructions.humidity: Moderate; ensure good air circulation

name: Marigold
description: Cheerful annual flowers in bright orange, yellow, and red hues. Marigolds are easy to grow, bloom profusely, and have pest-repelling properties, making them ideal companions in vegetable gardens.

careInstructions.light: Full sun for best blooms; tolerates partial shade
careInstructions.water: Water when soil surface is dry; avoid overhead watering
careInstructions.humidity: Low to moderate; very heat tolerant

name: Bougainvillea
description: Vigorous climbing plant with vibrant, papery bracts in magenta, purple, red, orange, or white. Creates stunning cascades of color on walls, trellises, and pergolas in warm climates.

careInstructions.light: Full sun; needs 6+ hours for prolific blooming
careInstructions.water: Allow soil to dry between waterings; drought tolerant once established
careInstructions.humidity: Low to moderate; thrives in dry heat

name: Boston Fern
description: Lush, feathery fronds create a full, graceful appearance. This classic fern adds a touch of Victorian elegance to shaded porches and patios, and can also thrive indoors with proper humidity.

careInstructions.light: Bright indirect light to partial shade
careInstructions.water: Keep soil consistently moist; never let dry out completely
careInstructions.humidity: High; mist daily or use humidity tray

name: Lavender
description: Aromatic herb with purple-blue flower spikes and silvery-green foliage. Beloved for its calming fragrance, drought tolerance, and ability to attract pollinators while repelling pests.

careInstructions.light: Full sun; at least 6-8 hours daily
careInstructions.water: Water sparingly; drought tolerant once established
careInstructions.humidity: Low; prefers dry conditions

name: Cactus Mix
description: Collection of diverse cacti featuring unique shapes, sizes, and occasional blooms. These desert plants are incredibly low-maintenance and add sculptural interest to sunny spots.

careInstructions.light: Bright direct light; south-facing window ideal
careInstructions.water: Water sparingly; every 2-4 weeks depending on season
careInstructions.humidity: Very low; adapted to arid conditions

name: Assorted Succulents
description: Diverse collection of plump, water-storing plants in various colors and forms. Perfect for dish gardens, terrariums, or small pots, these forgiving plants are ideal for busy lifestyles.

careInstructions.light: Bright light; some direct sun beneficial
careInstructions.water: Water when soil is completely dry; every 1-2 weeks
careInstructions.humidity: Low; very drought tolerant
